source.title: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/2041 of 11 September 2026 laying down rules for the application of Directive 2009/138/EC of the European Parliament and of the Council as regards technical information for the calculation of technical provisions and basic own funds for reporting with reference dates from 30 June 2026 until 29 September 2026

affectedEntities: Insurance and reinsurance undertakings applying Directive 2009/138/EC

analysis.summary: The Commission published implementing rules supplying technical information for calculating technical provisions and basic own funds under Directive 2009/138/EC for the stated reporting reference-date range.
keyPoints: The act concerns technical information used to calculate technical provisions and basic own funds.
Its title identifies reporting reference dates from 30 June 2026 until 29 September 2026.
businessTakeaways: Insurance prudential reporting and actuarial teams should confirm that calculations for the covered reference dates use the applicable technical information.
suggestedActions: Open the official act and compare its technical inputs with the values used in the relevant reporting cycle.

importantDates.label: End of the reporting reference-date range identified in the title

source.title: Decision (EU) 2026/2039 of the European Central Bank of 1 September 2026 nominating heads of work units to adopt joint decisions on the assessment of group recovery plans (ECB/2026/23)

affectedEntities: Banking groups whose recovery plans are assessed jointly

analysis.summary: The ECB nominated heads of work units who may adopt joint decisions concerning assessments of group recovery plans.
keyPoints: The decision concerns internal authority to adopt joint group-recovery-plan assessment decisions.
businessTakeaways: Banking groups may wish to note the decision-making delegation when tracking supervisory recovery-plan assessments.
suggestedActions: Review the official decision if an active group recovery-plan assessment depends on the identified ECB decision-making arrangements.

source.title: Decision (EU) 2026/2040 of the European Central Bank of 1 September 2026 nominating heads of work units to adopt delegated decisions on material changes to rating systems for calculating own funds requirements for credit risk (ECB/2026/24)

affectedEntities: Credit institutions seeking approval for material rating-system changes

analysis.summary: The ECB nominated heads of work units who may adopt delegated decisions on material rating-system changes used to calculate own-funds requirements for credit risk.
keyPoints: The decision concerns delegated authority for decisions on material rating-system changes.
Those rating systems are used in calculating own-funds requirements for credit risk.
businessTakeaways: Prudential model and regulatory teams may wish to note the delegation when following an approval process for material rating-system changes.
suggestedActions: Open the official decision when planning or tracking a material rating-system change that may require ECB approval.
